3:92: Ur teţţawḍem ar ţţuba, d awezɣi, alamma tseddqem seg wayen tḥemmlem. Kra n wayen tseddqem n cci, ihi, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa t.
3:93: Yal lqut illa iḥell i At Isṛail, siwa ayen igdel Isṛail i iman is, uqbel a d ters Tuṛa. Ini: "awit ed Tuṛa, ɣeṛt eţ, ma tessawalem tideţ".
3:94: Wid id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, deffir waya, nitni d imednas.
3:95: Ini: "Inna d Ṛebbi tideţ; ddut d ddin n Ibṛahim, i imalen ar tideţ, ur nelli seg imcurak".
3:96: Ih, axxam amezwaru, i irsen i medden, war ccekk, d win n Bekka. Iṛqa, d nnhaya i imaḍalen.
3:97: Degs issekniyen iberrzen; d axxam n Ibṛahim. Win it ikecmen, atan di laman. I Ṛebbi, iwata ad ḥuoen medden s Axxam, ma zemren a t awḍen. Win iugin, ihi, Rebbi ur Iḥwao ara imaḍalen.
3:98: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tnekṛem issekniyen n Ṛebbi"? Ṛebbi d Anagi n wayen txeddmem.
3:99: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teṭṭeṛṛifem, wid iumnen, seg ubrid n Ṛebbi? Tessaramem t iaɛwej, u kunwi d inagan". Ur Iɣfil Ṛebbi ɣef wayen txeddmem.
3:100: A wid iumnen! Ma tuɣem awal i urbaɛ, seg wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, a kwen rren d ijehliyen, deffir liman nnwen.
3:101: Amek tnekṛem, u kunwi ɣṛan awen d issekniyen n Ṛebbi, u, garawen, Amazan iS? Win iṭṭfen di Ṛebbi, niɣ iţwanha s abrid uwqim.
3:102: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, akken Iklal aḥezzeb. Ur ţţemmtet alamma tunzem.
3:103: Eṭfet akw di teḥmilt n Ṛebbi, ur ţţemfaṛaqet. Mmektit ed ayen ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi. Mi tellam d icenga, Issemlal ulawen nnwen. S lɣit iS, tuɣalem d atmaten. Tellam ɣef rrif n maylellif n tmes, Isellek ikwen segs. Akka i wen Iţbeggin Ṛebbi issekniyen iS, amendeṛ ma a ţţeţwanhum.
3:104: Amar ad yili, segwen, lois i ineccden ar lxiṛ, iţţamṛen lqanun, itekksen ayen n dir. Widak d imerbaḥ.
3:105: Ur ţţilit am wid imfaṛaqen, u mgarraden, deffir n tisin ubeggen ɣuṛsen. I widak, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan,
3:106: ass ideg ara imlulen wudmawen, ara ibriken wudmawen. Wanag wid iwumi ara ibriken wudmawen nnsen: "tnekṛem, deffir liman nnwen? Jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb, ilmend n wayen tnekṛem".
3:107: Wanag wid iwumi ara a imlulen wudmawen nnsen, ad ilin deg uḥunu n Ṛebbi. Nitni, degs, ad wekkṛen.
3:108: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Neqqaṛ ak ten id, s tideţ. Ur Ibɣi Ṛebbi ddens i imaḍalen.
3:109: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ar Ṛebbi tuɣalin n lumuṛ.
3:110: Tifem akw leoyus id iffɣen i medden. Teţţamṛem lqanun, teţţekksem ayen n dir, tumnem s Ṛebbi. Pţif, i At Tezmamt, lemmer uminen. Garasen lmumnin; tegwti degsen d iballaɣen.
3:111: Cwiṭ kan ara kwen ḍuṛṛen. Ma nnuɣen kwen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur sɛun amɛiwen.
3:112: Iwwet iten ddell anda ma llan, siwa wid iṭṭfen di teḥmilt n Ṛebbi, u di teḥmilt n medden. Lqan urrif n Ṛebbi, u teɣli d tiggulelt fellasen. Ayagi, acku llan nekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, la neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi ɛuṣan u zgaren tilas.
3:113: Ur aɛdilen. Illa lois, seg At Tezmamt, i iqqaṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi deg iḍ, u nitni kennun.
3:114: Umnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, ţţamṛen lqanun, tekksen ayen n dir, ţḥirin ar lxiṛ. Widak seg iɛaṛḍiyen.
3:115: Ayen xedmen n lxiṛ, ur asen iţwankaṛ. Ṛebbi Issen wid iţḥezziben.
3:116: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur asen d iţţawi acemma, ar Ṛebbi, wayla nnsen, neɣ tarwa nnsen. Widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkṛen.
3:117: Amedya n wayen ţseṛṛifen di tmeddurt n ddunit agi, am umedya n waḍu, degs abruri. Iḥuza iger n ugdud idensen iman is. Isnegr it. Ur ten Idnis Ṛebbi; d iman nnsen ay dennisen.
3:118: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţarat d iḥbiben, wur nelli segwen. Ur zgalen a kwen hewwlen. Bɣan a kwen hejjnen. Niɣ ibda d lbweɣḍ seg imawen nnsen. Ayen iffren deg ulawen nnsen, iɣelb it. Niɣ Nbeggen awen ed issekniyen, ma teţmeyyizem.
3:119: Atan kunwi d wid i ten iḥemmlen, ur kwen ḥemmlen. Tumnem di Tezmamt, s lekmal is. Ma mmugren kwen, ad inin: "numen". Mi ɣaben, ad ɣeẓẓen iḍudan nnsen si zzɛaf fellawen. Ini: "emmtet si zzɛaf nnwen"! Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg idmaren.
3:120: Ma iusa kwen id iseɣ, a ten isnuɣben. Ma teḍṛa yidwen tucmiţ, ad feṛḥen yis. Ma tṣebṛem, u tḥezbem, ur kwen teṭṭuṛṛu s wacemma, tandit nnsen. Niɣ Izzi Ṛebbi i wayen xeddmen.
3:121: Mi teffɣeḍ, ṣṣbeḥ zik, si twacult ik, temmaleḍ i lmumnin imukan umennuɣ, Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
3:122: Mi qṛib feclent snat n trebbuyaɛ nnwen, u Ṛebbi d Bab nnsent. Iwata i yal lmumen, ad iţţkel ɣef Ṛebbi.
3:123: Niɣ Iɛiwen ikwen Ṛebbi di Badṛ, mi tellam tendellem. Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
3:124: Mi tenniḍ i lmumnin: "day ur testeqnaɛm ara, mi kwen Iɛiwen Ṛebbi s kraḍ igima n lmalayek, id irsen"?
3:125: Xaṭi, ma tṣebṛem u tḥezzbem, ma ɣewwsen d fellawen, a kwen Iɛiwen Mass nnwen, s smus igima n lmalayek ikkaten.
3:126: Ur Iga akka Ṛebbi, siwa i ubecceṛ nnwen, ad rtiḥen yis wulawen nnwen. Rrbeḥ sɣuṛ Ṛebbi kan, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
3:127: Iwakken ad Iṛẓ arbaɛ n wid ijehlen, neɣ a ten Iẓẓaɛ, ad uɣalen nneɣwnin.
3:128: Ur k iaɛna lameṛ s wacemma. Ad asen Issuref, neɣ a ten Iɛaqeb, nitni d imednas.
3:129: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Iţsemmiḥ i win i S ihwan. Iţɛaqab win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
3:130: A wid iumnen! Ur teţţet rrba iţzeggiden, teţzeggid. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem.
3:131: Ḥezzbet ilmend n tmes i iţţuheggan i ijehliyen.
3:132: Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan, amar ad yili uḥunu fellawen.
3:133: ɣiwlet ar ssmaḥ sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwsɛan am tmurt akked igenwan. Teţţuhegga d i wid iţḥezziben,
3:134: wid iţseddiqen - sɛan neɣ xuṣṣen -, wid isnusun reffu, wid iţsemmiḥen i medden - Ṛebbi Iḥemmel lɛuṣam -,
3:135: wid, ma xedmen tucmiţ, neɣ densen iman nnsen, a d mmektin Ṛebbi, ad steɣfṛen ɣef ibekkaḍen nnsen. Anwa Iţsemmiḥen ibekkaḍen siwa Ṛebbi? Ur ţgerninen deg wayen xedmen, u nitni ẓṛan.
3:136: Widak, akafi nnsen d ssmaḥ n Mass nnsen, akked leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. D arraz igerzen i wid issewqamen.
3:137: Ɛaddant tedyanin uqbel nnwen. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek teḍṛa d wid id iggaren tikerkas.
3:138: Wagi d abeggen i medden, d nnhaya akked unecced i wid iţḥezziben.
3:139: Ur ţţifcilet, ur ɣwebnet, d kunwi i iaɛlayen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
3:140: Ma iḥuza kwen lada, niɣ lada i t icban iḥuza agdud. Ussan agi Nerra ten, ger medden, d tidwal, iwakken ad Yissin Ṛebbi wid iumnen, ad Iddem segwen inagan. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara imednas.
3:141: Iwakken ad Ijeṛṛeb Ṛebbi wid iumnen, u ad Isqucc ijehliyen.
3:142: Day tɣilem a ţkecmem Loennet, wanag ur Iẓṛi ara Ṛebbi wid ijuhden segwen, ur Issin ara iṣebṛiyen?
3:143: Niɣ teţmennim tameţţant, uqbel a ţ id temmagrem. Niɣ twalam ţ, kunwi teţmuqulem.
3:144: Muḥemmed d Amazan kan. Niɣ ɛaddan imazanen, uqbel is. Ma immut neɣ iţwanɣa, day a ţţuɣalem ar deffir? Win ara iuɣalen ar deffir, ur iṭṭuṛṛu Ṛebbi s wacemma. Ṛebbi ad Ikafi wid isnemmiren.
3:145: Ur iţmeţţat umdan siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi, di lajel iuran. Win ibɣan akafi n ddunit, ad as t Nefk. Win ibɣan akafi n laxeṛt, ad as t Nefk. A Nkafi wid isnemmiren.
3:146: Acḥal n lambiyya i innuɣen, idda yidsen urbaɛ iqwan, ur fcilen seg wayen iten issaɛtben, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ur xuzen, ur fkin mayna. Ṛebbi Iḥemmel iṣebṛiyen.
3:147: Awal nnsen, siwa mi nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aɣ ibekkaḍen nneɣ, akked tugut nneɣ di lameṛ nneɣ. Tebbet isurifen nneɣ, Sserbeḥ aneɣ ɣef ugdud ijehliyen".
3:148: Ifka yasen Ṛebbi akafi n ddunit, akked ukafi lɛali n laxert. Ṛebbi Iḥemmel lɛuṣam.
3:149: A wid iumnen! Ma tuɣem awal i wid ijehlen, a kwen rren ar deffir, a ţţuɣalem txesṛem.
3:150: Xaṭi! Ṛebbi d Bab nnwen. Neţţa, Yif akw imɛiwnen.
3:151: A Nessekcem tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen, imi curken i Ṛebbi, ayen iwumi ur d irs ara udabu. Axxam nnsen d times. A yir tanezduɣt i imednas!
3:152: Niɣ Issawel awen Ṛebbi tideţ, di lemɛahda S, mi ten tesnegrem, s tsriḥ iS. Armi, mi tfeclem, temnamarem f lameṛ, taɛṣam mbaɛd ma Issken awen d ayen tḥemmlem. Garawen wid ibɣan ddunit, garawen wid ibɣan laxert. Sinna, Issebɛad ikwen fellasen, iwakken a kwen Ijeṛṛeb. Niɣ Isemmeḥ awen. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl i lmumnin.
3:153: Mi tulim ur d tezzim, u Nnbi inecced ikwen ar ineggura nnwen. Ineṣṣef awen aɣilif s wayeḍ, iwakken ur tɣwebnem ɣef wayen i wen iṛuḥen, akked wayen ikwen iuɣen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
3:154: Sinna, deffir uɣilif, Issers awen d laman, iḍes id iɣlin ɣef urbaɛ segwen. Niɣ arbaɛ ţḥebbiṛen ɣef yiman nnsen, nnwan, ɣef Ṛebbi, ayen ur nelli d tideţ, nnwaya n at war tussna. Qqaṛen: "day illa wayen i ɣ iaɛnan, di lameṛ"? Ini: "s tideţ, lameṛ akw i Ṛebbi". Teffren, deg iman nnsen, ayen ur ak mmalen. Qqaṛen: "lemmer illi wayen i ɣ iaɛnan, di lameṛ, ur neţwanɣa dagi". Ini: "xas ma tellam deg ixxamen nnwen, wid iɣef tura tmenɣiwt, a ten taweḍ s imṭeṛḥen nnsen. Iwakken ad Ijeṛṛeb Ṛebbi i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ad Izzizdeg i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan deg idmaren.
3:155: Ih, wid segwen iwexxṛen asmi mlalent trebbuyaɛ, d Cciṭan kan iten iccacḍen, ilmend n kra n wayen kesben. Niɣ Isemmeḥ asen Ṛebbi. Akka, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iḥellem.
3:156: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţilit am wid ijehlen. Nnan i watmaten nnsen iunagen di tmurt, neɣ iţnaɣen: "lemmer llin ɣuṛneɣ, ur mmuten, ur twanɣan". Ad Irr Ṛebbi, ayagi, d aneggaf deg ulawen nnsen! Ṛebbi Issidir, Ineqq. Ṛebbi Iţwali ayen txeddmem.
3:157: Ma teţwanɣam deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, neɣ temmutem, ssmaḥ n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu, war ccekk, ifen ayen la jemɛan.
3:158: Ma temmutem neɣ teţwanɣam, war ccekk, ar Ṛebbi ara teţwafesrem.
3:159: S uḥunu n Ṛebbi, tḥelmeḍ ɣuṛsen. Lemmer tqeṣḥeḍ, tesɣaṛeḍ ul ik, ad baɛden fellak. Semmeḥ asen, ssuter ad ţţusemmḥen, ciweṛ iten ɣef lameṛ. Mi tseyyiḍ, ţţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iḥemmel wid iţţkalen.
3:160: Ma Iɛiwen ikwen Ṛebbi, ur kwen irennu yiwen. Ma Iooa kwen, anwa illan a kwen iɛiwen, deffir eS? ɣef Ṛebbi ara ţţeklen lmumnin.
3:161: Ur issefk ara i nnbi ad idnes. Win idensen, a d ias s wayen idnes, ass n tnekra. Sinna, yal wa, ad as iţţunefk wayen ikseb. Nitni, ur ten ţmeṛṛiṛen.
3:162: Day win iddan d llza n Ṛebbi am win isebebben urrif n Ṛebbi, u tanezduɣt is d Loahennama? A taggara tucmiţ!
3:163: Ur aɛdilen ar Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iţwali acu xeddmen.
3:164: Niɣ Ṛebbi Iɣat lmumnin, mi sen d Iuzen Amazan segsen, immal asen issekniyen iS, izzizdig iten, isseḥfaḍ asen Tazmamt akked ṣṣwab, ulamma llan, zik, di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
3:165: Ma tuɣem tiyta, niɣ terram ţ berdayen. Tennam: "ansi waya"? Ini: "aya seg iman nnwen". Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer i yal cci.
3:166: Ayen ikwen iwwten, ass n temlilit n trebbuyaɛ, s tsriḥ n Ṛebbi. Iwakken ad Iẓeṛ anwi ay d lmumnin,
3:167: u ad Iẓeṛ anwi ay d ixabiten. Nnan asen: "yyaw, nnaɣet deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, neɣ ẓedmet". Nnan: "lemmer nessin a nennaɣ, yili nedda n yidwen". Assen, nitni, ar tijehli, neɣ ɣeṛ liman, ay qeṛben kteṛ. Qqaren, s yimawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Iẓṛa ayen teffren.
3:168: Wid innan i watmaten nnsen, u nitni qqimen: "lemmer i ɣ ssemḥessen, ur ţwanɣen". Ini: "sdarit iman nnwen si tmeţţant, ma tessawalem tideţ ".
3:169: Ur ţɣili mmuten wid iţwanɣan deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Xaṭi, d imuddiren. Ad ţţuṛeẓqen ar Mass nnsen.
3:170: Ad feṛḥen s wayen i sen Ifka Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS. Zhan, imi wid deffir sen, mazal ur ten id nelḥiq, ur ţţagawaden, ur ɣweblen.
3:171: Zhan s lɣit n Ṛebbi, akked lfeḍl. Ṛebbi ur Iḍeggiɛ arraz n lmumnin;
3:172: wid id ijawben i Ṛebbi akked Umazan, mbaɛd ma sɛaddan lḥif. Arraz ameqwṛaḥan i wid, segsen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u ḥezzben;
3:173: wid iwumi nnan medden: "niɣ mlalen fellawen imdanen, ihi, agwadet ţen". Dɣa isnerna liman nnsen, nnan: "Iqadd aɣ Ṛebbi, Awkil Amxallef".
3:174: Uɣalen d s lɣit n Ṛebbi akked lfeḍl, ur ten innul cceṛṛ; ddan d llza n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
3:175: Akka kan ay d Cciṭan. Issagwad s imeddukwal is. Ur ten ţţagwadet, agwadet iyI, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
3:176: Ur k ɣwebbnen wid iţɣawalen ar tijehli. Nitni, s tideţ, ur ḍḍuṛṛen Ṛebbi, s wacemma. Ibɣa Ṛebbi ur asen Iteg amur di laxert. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
3:177: Ih, wid iuɣen tijehli s liman, ur ḍḍuṛṛen Ṛebbi s wacemma. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
3:178: Ur ḥeţţben wid ijehlen, ar telha yasen, lmudda i sen Nefka. Nefka yasen kan lmudda, iwakken ad rnun ibekkaḍen. Fellasen aɛaqeb isdullun.
3:179: Ur illi di lebɣi n Ṛebbi, ad Ioo lmumnin di liḥala nnwen, alamma Ifrez axabit seg umɛin. Ur illi di lebɣi n Ṛebbi, ad awen Imel tabaḍnit. Maca, Iferren Ṛebbi wid i S ihwan, d imazanen iS. Ihi, amnet s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS. Ma tumnem, u tḥezzbem, a ţţawim arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
3:180: Ur ḥeţţben wid iţcuḥḥun deg wayen i sen Ifka Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS, ard lxiṛ nnsen. Xaṭi, d cceṛṛ nnsen. Ayen cuḥḥen a ten iarez seg umgaṛḍ, ass n tnekra. I Ṛebbi, lweṛt n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
3:181: Niɣ Isla Ṛebbi i wawal n wid innan: "s tideţ, Ṛebbi d igellil, nekwni d isɛayen". A Naru ayen nnan, akked wayen nɣan n lambiyya, war ssebba. Ad asen Nini: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb ujajiḥ".
3:182: Ayagi, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnwen. Ṛebbi ur Iţdennis imdanen.
3:183: Wid innan: "Ih, Ṛebbi Iɛahed aɣ ur neţţamen s Umazan, alamma issenɛat aɣ d asfel, ara tečč tmes". Ini: "niɣ usan kwen id imazanen, uqbel iw, s ubeggen, akw s wayen d tennam. Ihi, acimi i ten tenɣam, ma tessawalem tideţ"?
3:184: Ma skaddben k, niɣ skaddben imazanen, uqbel ik, usan d s ubeggen, Ihellilen, akked Tezmamt timnewweṛt.
3:185: Yal iman ad ijeṛṛeb tameţţant. Ass n tnekra, ad awen iţţunefk, kan, warraz nnwen. Win isellken si tmes, ikecmen Loennet, niɣ irbeḥ. Tameddurt, di ddunit, d zzhu kan iţɣuṛṛun.
3:186: A ţţeţţujeṛṛbem deg wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen. Ad wwten aṭas degwen, wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akked imcurak. Ma tṣebṛem u tḥezzbem, ayagi, s tideţ, d ayen isselḥayen lumuṛ.
3:187: Mi Iṭṭef Ṛebbi laɛqed n wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt: "a ţ tbeggnem i medden, ur ţ teţţeffrem". Rran ţ deffir izugar nnsen, uɣen yis, ayen irxisen. I icmet wayen uɣen!
3:188: Ur ţɣili ad sellken, seg uɛaqeb, wid ifeṛḥen s wayen fkan, u bɣan a ten ccekṛen ɣef wayen ur xdimen. Fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
3:189: N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
3:190: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, akked umgirred n yiḍ akked wass, d issekniyen i uɛqilen;
3:191: Wid id ismektayen Ṛebbi s ibeddi, s iɣimi, s tuẓẓla. Pmeyyizen lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan. A Mass nneɣ! Ur Texliqeḍ aya d aḥerfi. Gedha s yiseK! Sellek aɣ seg uɛaqeb n tmes.
3:192: A Mass nneɣ! Niɣ, s tideţ, Kečč, Texziḍ win Teskecmeḍ ar tmes. Ur llin wid ara isellken imednas.
3:193: A Mass nneɣ! S tideţ, nesla i uneccad, la inecced ar liman: "amnet s Mass nnwen"! Numen. A Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aɣ ibekkaḍen nneɣ, Kkes aneɣ tucmitin nneɣ, Ssiweḍ aɣ, ar ssmaḥ iK, akked wid zeddigen.
3:194: A Mass nneɣ! Efk aneɣ ayen i aɣ Tɛahdeḍ s imazanen iK; ur aɣ Xezzu ass n tnekra. Kečč, s tideţ, ur Tzegleḍ lemɛahda.
3:195: Irra yasen Mass nnsen: "Nek ur Veggiɛeɣ igi n win, segwen, issewqamen, d ddkeṛ neɣ d nnta. Wa ikka d seg wa. Wid iunagen, u ssuffɣen ten seg ixxamen nnsen, iɛatben deg ubrid iW, innuɣen, iţwanɣan, war ccekk, ad asen Kkseɣ tucmitin nnsen, a ten Skecmeɣ ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen". D akafi sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, ɣuṛeS akafi amxallef.
3:196: Ur k iţqelliq lexdaɛ n wid ijehlen di temdint.
3:197: Cwiṭ n zzhu, sinna, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A yir usu!
3:198: Maca, i wid iḥezzben i Mass nnsen: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen, d inebgawen n Ṛebbi. U d wayen illan ar Ṛebbi, d amxallef i izedganen.
3:199: Ih, seg wAt Tezmamt, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi, s wayen akw i wen ed irsen, akked s wayen i sen d irsen. Unzen i Ṛebbi, ur uɣen ara s issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ayen ṛxisen. I widak, arraz sɣuṛ Mass nnsen. Niɣ Ṛebbi Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
3:200: A wid iumnen! Ṣebṛet, aznet ṣṣbeṛ, begset, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, amar a ţrebḥem.
4:1: A yimdanen! Ḥezzbet i Mass nnwen, ikwen Ixelqen seg yiwen n lxelq, u Ixelq ed segs ayugan is. Issuffeɣ ed, segsen, aṭas n yirgazen akked tlawin. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi iɣef teţmesteqsayem, akw i tɛabbuḍin. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Iquṛaɛ kwen.
4:2: Efket ayla nnsen i igujilen, ur ţţarat dduni deg umkan n lɛali. Ur ţţarat ayla nnsen d ayla nnwen. Ih, wagi d abekkaḍ ameqwṛan.
4:3: Ma tugadem ur tweznem ara ar igujilen, aɣet ayen i wen ihwan n tlawin: snat, kraḍt, kuẓt. Ma tugadem ur tessaɛdalem ara, yiwet kan, neɣ taklatin nnwen. Akka i iwulem, ur ţţakwret.
4:4: Efket tuččit nnsent i tlawin, d tikci. Ma rrant awen d kra segs, s lebɣi nnsent, ččet eţ, s lfeṛḥ akked llza.
4:5: Ur ţţaket i ijeɣlufen ayla nnwen, win i wen Ifka Ṛebbi i tmeddurt. Ṛeẓqet ţen segs, sselset ţen, ẓẓiẓdet awal nnwen ɣuṛsen.
4:6: Jeṛṛbet igujilen, alamma bbwḍen i jjwao. Ma tufam ten ẓewṛen, efket asen ayla nnsen. Ur ten teţţet s uḍeggaɛ d usexseṛ, uqbel ad imɣuṛen. Ameṛkanti ad iḥezzeb, ameɣbun ad ičč s lekyasa. Mara sen tefkem ayla nnsen, s inagan fellas. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi i leḥsab.
4:7: I yirgazen, amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. I tlawin amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. Ama cwiṭ, neɣ aṭas, d amur ilezmen.
4:8: Ma ḥedṛen, i ufṛaq, llzem, igujilen, igellilen, ṛeẓqet ţen segs, tinem asen awal uṣwib.
4:9: Ad agwaden wid id iooan, deffir sen, tarwa tagellilt. Ad agwaden fellasen. Ad ḥezzben i Ṛebbi, s wawal iweznen.
4:10: Ih, wid iteţţen, s ddens, ayla igujilen, la teţţen kan times deg iɛabbaḍ nnsen, ad ţwagren deg ujajiḥ.
4:11: ɣef tarwa nnwen, Iweṣṣa kwen Ṛebbi: i uqcic amur n snat tullas. Ma llant sennig snat n tullas, nnsent amur wis kuẓ n lweṛt. Ma yiwet i illan, ines uzgen. I imawlan is, i yal wa, amur wis sdis n wayen id iooa, ma isɛa mmi s. Ma ur isɛa ara mmi s, u weṛten t imawlan is, amur wis kuẓ i immas. Ma isɛa atmaten, i immas amur wis sdis, kkes ed ayen iţţuseṛfen neɣ ṭlabat. Imawlan nnwen, arraw nnwen, ur teẓṛim ara menyif iten, akken i kwen nefɛan. D aḥeţţem n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
4:12: Nnwen uzgen n wayen id ooant tlawin nnwen, ma ur sɛint ara tarwa. Ma sɛant mmit sent, i kunwi amur wis kuẓ n wayen id ooant, kkes ed ayen iţţuseṛfen neɣ ṭlabat. I nitenti, amur wis kuẓ n wayen id teooam, ma ur tesɛim ara mmit wen. Ma tesɛam mmit wen, i nitenti amur wis ṭam n wayen id teooam, kkes ed ayen iţţuseṛfen neɣ ṭlabat. Ma d argaz awḥid neɣ d tameṭṭut tawḥiṭ, ma isɛa agmat neɣ taultmaţ, i yal wa segsen, amur wis sdis. Ma deg waṭas ay llan, ad feṛqen amur wis kraḍ, war ccqa, kkes ed ayen iţţuseṛfen neɣ ṭlabat. D aweṣṣi n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, Iḥellem.
4:13: D tigi ay d tilisa n Ṛebbi. Win issemḥessen i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
4:14: Win iɛuṣan Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, izegren tilas iS, a t Issekcem ar tmes, degs ad iwekkeṛ, ad isɛaddi aɛaqeb isdullun.
4:15: I tid ixedmen lɛaṛ di tlawin nnwen, awit ed, fellasent, kuẓ inagan nnwen. Ma cehhden d, kemnet ţent di texxamin, alamma teddem itent tmeţţant, neɣ Iga yasent Ṛebbi abrid.
4:16: Wid segwen it ixedmen, ɛaqbet ţen. Ma nedmen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, anfet asen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
4:17: Issuruf kan Ṛebbi i wid ixedmen cceṛṛ ur ẓṛin, sinna, steṛoɛen, war laɛḍil. Widak, ad asen Issuref Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Izga d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
4:18: Ur illi usuref i wid ixedmen tucmitin. Alamma, mi d tusa yiwen tmeţţant, a d yini: "nek steṛoɛeɣ tura". Akken, wid immuten u nitni d ijehliyen. Widak, Nhegga yasen d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
4:19: A wid iumnen! Ur awen iḥell ara a ţweṛten tilawin, ur qbilent, neɣ ad asent tekksem jjwao, iwakken a ţţawim amur seg wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma xedment lɛaṛ ibanen. Illit yidsent, s lqanun. Ma tkeṛhem tent, ahat tkeṛhem ayen ideg Irra Ṛebbi lxiṛ meqqwṛen.
4:20: Ma tebɣam a ţbedlem tameṭṭut s tayeḍ, u tefkam tuččit i yiwet, ur as tekkset acemma. Ma tekksem, d ayen n dir u d abekkaḍ n ṣṣeḥ.
4:21: Amek ara tekksem imi temyekcamem, u bbwint sɣuṛwen laɛqed meqqwṛen?
4:22: Ur ţţaɣet tilawin i uɣen ibabaten nnwen, kkes ed ayen iɛaddan. Ayagi, s tideţ, d lɛaṛ, d dduni, d yir brid.
4:23: Pwadeglent awen tyimmatin nnwen, issit nnwen, tissetmatin nnwen, tiɛamtiwin nnwen, tixaltitin nnwen, issit n ugmat, issit n tweltmaţ, tiyimmatin nnwen i kwen issuṭṭḍen, tissetmatin nnwen ukud teṭṭḍem, tiḍegwalin nnwen, issit id tessekrem n tlawin nnwen ukud tcerkem usu - ma ur tecrikem ara usu, ulac uɣilif -, tilawin n warraw id turwem. Ur zdukulet snat tsetmatin, kkes ed ayen iɛaddan, - Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu -,
